title: AC1015 LTYPE inline handle-tail bounded import profile
status: bounded local compatibility evidence; no format support promotion

source.provenance: Existing local source; producer provenance is not authenticated
source.observation: The LTYPE control lists 25 entries. Three exact built-in names (BYBLOCK, BYLAYER, CONTINUOUS) are name-only; the remaining 22 bodies parse with the observed inline-handle size profile. Some simple segments have omitted terminal null dash handles.

specification.authority: Open Design Alliance Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
specification.note: The compatibility path is bounded to this observed AC1015 source profile. The body/inline-handle boundary and omitted terminal null handles are observations, not a replacement for the normative field layout or a producer-wide rule.

profiles: name-only import for the three exact AC1015 built-in names when the declared body ends immediately after the name
parse inline handle tail only when the typed body stops before the declared object boundary and require exact consumption
tolerate exhausted trailing null dash handles only when every remaining segment has no shape or text resource
refuse a missing common handle tail and permit same-parser retry after refusal

validation.physicalRead: A debug conversion of the pinned sample reports no LTYPE parser warnings and advances to the subsequent LAYER record, where parsing fails with BAD_READ_TABLES.
validation.qualification: Does not qualify the complete AC1015 file, layer parsing, output, producer interoperability, or support claims.

peerDisposition: LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON/debug output for this source reports malformed LTYPE fields and is not used as an independent semantic oracle.
